capabilities: render ftags as chips at the top of file views
remove an ftag connection via a chip button
move files with no non-inbox ftags to the inbox folder
show child notes as chips below the ftag chips
open the file menu from chips on right-click
extras: Warns that it uses file system APIs that move files and modify symlinks in frontmatter, and recommends backing up the vault; the README also lists many companion plugins by the same author.
intentEvidence: If you have crosslink-advanced enabled, a button for adding new tags appears to the left of the tags
problem: Ftags assigned via clones and symlinks have no visible representation when a file is open, so you cannot see or manage a file's tag hierarchy in the editor.

relations.evidence: If you have crosslink-advanced enabled, a button for adding new tags appears to the left of the tags

summary: Displays a file's ftags (clone/symlink-based tags) and child notes as styled chips at the top of the markdown view.
